description:
Redwood Inference is PLG-led, but a growing share of revenue expansion comes from sales-assisted upgrades to Dedicated and Private when customers hit scale, reliability, or compliance needs. This project (“PLG-to-sales signal routing + playbook”) implements a reliable, privacy-aware signal pipeline that detects usage thresholds and intent signals (e.g., sustained token volume, spend velocity, repeated 429s, security/SOC2 doc views, Dedicated/Private docs interest, multi-workspace/team expansion), enriches them with account context, and routes them into HubSpot for automated task creation and ownership assignment. It also delivers an enablement playbook defining which signals matter, how AEs/SEs/CSMs should follow up, and what cadence to use—aiming to increase conversion from self-serve to sales-assisted while minimizing spam and false positives.

Goals:
- Define the canonical set of “sales-worthy” product-led signals (threshold + intent) and their definitions.
- Implement event ingestion + aggregation (daily/weekly windows), deduping, and scoring into a “PLG Signal” object.
- Route qualified signals into HubSpot as company activities + tasks, with deterministic ownership rules (region/tier/round-robin + existing owner preservation).
- Launch a follow-up cadence (email + call + in-product touchpoints where applicable) with clear exit criteria.
- Instrument outcomes (contacted, meeting booked, evaluation started, Dedicated/Private pipeline created) to measure impact.

Scope:
- Product telemetry → analytics dataset → signal scoring service → HubSpot API integration.
- HubSpot configuration (custom properties, workflows, task templates).
- Sales enablement assets (talk tracks, qualification checklist, cadence steps, objections, handoff to SE/CS).
- Rollout plan (pilot with NA team + limited cohort), monitoring, and iteration.

Out of scope (initial phase):
- Building a full in-house sequencing tool (use HubSpot tasks/templates first).
- Fully automated outbound without human review for early cohorts.

Primary stakeholders:
- Exec sponsor: Jordan Blake (CRO)
- GTM leads: Stephanie Nguyen (VP Sales NA), Camila Reyes (VP Marketing), Ben Carter (Growth)
- Product: Nikhil Sharma (Hosted API)
- Engineering: Logan Wright (Telemetry & Analytics), Priya Natarajan (Platform)
- Solutions Engineering: Markus Klein
- Security/Compliance review: Dr. Aisha Rahman / Marcus Lin
- CS alignment: Jasmine Liu

Timeline (typical):
- Phase 0 (1–2 weeks): signal definitions, success metrics, privacy review.
- Phase 1 (3–5 weeks): data contract + aggregation + scoring MVP; HubSpot custom properties and basic routing.
- Phase 2 (3–4 weeks): cadence templates + enablement; pilot rollout and quality tuning.
- Phase 3 (ongoing): expand cohorts/regions; add intent enrichment and outcome attribution.

Key deliverables:
- PRD + ADRs for signal schema, scoring, and routing architecture.
- HubSpot company records populated with signal history and next-step tasks.
- A sales playbook with cadence and qualification guidance.
- Dashboards and operational runbooks (monitoring, rate limits, retries, data correctness).

files.description: PRD: problem statement, target users (AEs/SEs/CS), signal taxonomy (threshold vs intent), MVP vs later phases, success metrics (meeting rate, opp creation, conversion to Dedicated/Private), rollout plan, and risks (noise/spam, data privacy, HubSpot limits).
ADR defining the canonical signal schema (fields, enums, time windows, dedupe keys), event sources, scoring approach, and versioning strategy; includes rationale and alternatives considered.
ADR describing routing rules (existing owner preservation, region mapping, round-robin fallback), task creation rules, re-notification thresholds, and auditability requirements.
Sales playbook: which signals trigger outreach, recommended messaging by signal type (scale, reliability, compliance), discovery questions, meeting goals, and handoff points to SE/CS.
Guidance mapping usage thresholds and pain signals to upgrade recommendations (Hosted→Dedicated vs Hosted→Private), with pricing/packaging guardrails and discount/credit escalation paths.
Security FAQ tailored for PLG expansions: audit logs, retention controls, data residency, SSO/SAML, KMS; includes “when to loop in security/SE” guidance.
Data governance doc: what customer data is used for signals, PII minimization, retention periods, access controls, and how to support deletion requests; notes security sign-off checkpoints.
Process doc for handoff between Sales and CS: when CS gets notified, how to avoid conflicting outreach, and how to use signal history during QBRs and expansion planning.
Working doc: brainstorming list of candidate signals, proposed thresholds, open questions (false positives, trial vs paid), and notes from early stakeholder interviews.
Spreadsheet-style table: last-30d self-serve accounts, usage distributions (tokens/day, spend velocity, error rates), proposed cut lines, and estimated weekly signal volume per region.
Draft cadence templates (Day 0/2/5/10), email snippets, LinkedIn note placeholders, call talk track, and exit criteria; includes internal review comments.
Spec for HubSpot setup: custom properties, lists, workflows, task templates, and required API scopes; includes a checklist for Ops to implement.
PM ticket to finalize signal definitions, thresholds, and success metrics; includes stakeholder review notes and links to the PRD/working analysis sheet.
PM ticket for pilot rollout plan: cohort selection, guardrails, measurement plan, and a weekly review cadence with Sales/Growth.
Engineering ticket to implement daily aggregation over usage telemetry, including dedupe keys, backfills, and unit tests; links to ADR schema v1.
Engineering ticket to write HubSpot integration (company lookup, property upserts, activity notes, task creation) with retries, rate-limit handling, and audit logs.
Engineering ticket focused on noise controls: suppression windows, minimum confidence thresholds, and an allow/deny list for internal/test orgs.
Ticket to add dashboards/alerts for pipeline health (event lag, HubSpot API failures, task creation counts) and oncall handoff.
Design ticket with lightweight mock for a “signal review queue” (initially as a HubSpot view + optional internal page later), focusing on reducing spam and enabling quick triage.
PM/Enablement ticket to finalize the playbook, incorporate Sales/SE feedback, and publish in Confluence; includes checklist for training session.
PR adding the signal schema (protobuf/JSON), validation utilities, and versioning; references PM-482 and ADR schema v1; includes reviewer feedback on naming and dedupe keys.
PR implementing a daily aggregation job (windowing, backfill support, idempotency) and writing results to an analytics table; links to ENG-7732.
PR introducing a HubSpot API client wrapper with token refresh, exponential backoff, and structured logs; includes CI notes and load testing results; links to ENG-7750.
PR wiring scoring output to HubSpot: update company properties, append timeline note, create follow-up task, and tag the signal type; links to PM-496 and ENG-7750.
PR adding suppression windows, internal org filtering, and minimum-volume requirements; includes discussion on tradeoffs between recall and noise; links to ENG-7801.
PR adding metrics (created_signals, routed_tasks, hubspot_429s, hubspot_5xx, lag_seconds) and wiring to dashboards; links to ENG-7824.
HubSpot company record for a PLG account showing rapid token growth, repeated 429s, and Dedicated interest; includes owner assignment, timeline of routed signals, and next-step tasks.
HubSpot company record for a regulated healthcare SaaS prospect triggered by security-faq views + VPC inquiry; includes compliance requirements and a scheduled security review call link.
HubSpot company record showing procurement-stage motion kicked off from a PLG signal; includes blockers (DPA, retention controls), stakeholders, and estimated ARR range.
HubSpot record for a high-throughput embeddings workload; signal includes sustained spend velocity and latency sensitivity; includes SE assignment and POC milestones.
HubSpot record for a mid-market account with Private deployment constraints; signal originated from Private deployment docs + API key rotation events; includes next-step plan and risks.
HubSpot record for a support-agent use case; signals include new workspaces + org invite spikes (team expansion); includes suggested multi-team rollout plan and CS involvement.
HubSpot record where an intent signal (pricing page + security FAQ + dedicated docs) is routed but later marked false positive; includes notes on suppression tuning.
HubSpot record for an EU account; signal includes regional growth and data residency concerns; includes routing to EMEA ownership and residency requirement notes.
Transcript: AE+SE follow-up triggered by usage spike and 429s; covers workload, scaling needs, Dedicated pitch, and next steps (benchmarks + pricing).
